subject: Pilot agreement: next steps and counsel review
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintegrate.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fintegrate.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: discovery + proposed pilot SOW

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today — appreciated the clarity on the ingestion volumes and the two pilot use-cases (search re-ranking + chat). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned:

- Scope: 3-month pilot, up to 10M tokens/month, staging + prod endpoints, redacted PII only stored in KV cache for 24 hours.
- Deliverables: Pilot SOW draft (attached), integration checklist, and a one-hour enablement session.
- Success criteria: 90th pctile latency < 220ms, cost per 1k tokens under target, and NPS on response quality > 4/5 for sample prompts.

Next actions (I’ll own):
1) Send draft SOW and procurement checklist (attached: Pilot_SOW_v1.docx).
2) If you’re comfortable, route the SOW to counsel/procurement — we can review redlines together.
3) Tentative kickoff week of Aug 30. I’ll block a 30-min sync if that works.

If priorities shifted on your side, tell me and we’ll adjust timing — otherwise I’ll follow up next week to check counsel progress.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/logan

[Attachment: Pilot_SOW_v1.docx (docx)]

- Procurement will want an initial pilot PO for the month + net-30 terms.

Samantha

Subject: Re: Pilot SOW — Fintegrate redlines (v2)

Logan / team —

Attached are our consolidated redlines. High-level summary of the requests:
- Data retention: extend certain debug log retention to 30 days; require masking of PII at rest.
- Indemnity & liability: propose mutual indemnities and a liability cap of 4x fees.
- Termination: require 45-day cure period for material breach; pilot termination language edits.
- SLA and remedies: request uptime credits and clarified definitions around scheduled maintenance.

We’ve provided inline comments in the PDF (Fintegrate_Redlines_v2.pdf). If you need to route anything to commercial/legal, please flag the items you will not accept so we can escalate internally.

Thanks,
Fintegrate Legal
legal@fintegrate.com
